description: This source file defines the 'NewsAppState' class, which manages the application state for a Flutter news application. It handles loading news articles from a local database or network, manages error states, and provides methods for refreshing categories and saving/deleting articles.

classes.name: NewsAppState
classes.description: A class extending ChangeNotifier that manages the app's news data, including fetching, caching, error handling, and user interactions like saving or deleting articles.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the application state by loading saved news and fetching categories from the network, with fallback to mock data on connectivity errors.

methods.name: articlesFor
methods.description: Returns a list of articles for a specified category.

methods.name: topHeadlines
methods.description: Returns a list of top headlines from the general category, limited by a predefined count.

methods.name: generalDownList
methods.description: Returns remaining general articles after top headlines have been taken.

methods.name: refreshCategory
methods.description: Refreshes a specific news category from the network, with fallback to mock data on errors.

methods.name: _fetchCategory
methods.description: Internal method to fetch news articles for a given category from the repository.

methods.name: _useMockForAllCategories
methods.description: Sets mock data for all categories in case of connectivity errors.

methods.name: isSaved
methods.description: Checks if an article with a specific headline is in the saved list.

methods.name: saveArticle
methods.description: Saves a news article to the local database and updates the saved list.

methods.name: deleteSavedByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a saved article by its headline and updates the saved list.

methods.name: undoSaveByHeadline
methods.description: Reverses a save action by deleting the article from saved items.
